module: Feeds the "trip" UI app: accumulates distance and simulation time, estimates fuel consumption and range, and sends the result to the UI about every real second via guihooks.trigger('tripData', data). Reads electrics.values.fuelVolume, wheelspeed and airspeed.
notes: The tripData event contains: totalDistance (m), avgSpeed (m/s), avgFuelConsumptionRate (fuel volume per meter, over the whole trip), fuelConsumptionRate (volume per meter over the last second), range (remaining distance, math.huge if no consumption and speed > 0.1, 0 at standstill).
The speed used is electrics.values.wheelspeed if the vehicle has wheels (wheels.wheels not empty), otherwise airspeed.
The send timer is counted down in real time (obj:getRealdt), the accumulations in simulation time (dtSim).

onExtensionLoaded returns false (which unloads the extension) if the vehicle has neither wheels nor a powertrain device; onPlayersChanged unloads it if no player is seated anymore or if the vehicle is unsuitable.
Possible division by zero in fuelConsumptionRate/avgFuelConsumptionRate when speed or totalDistance is 0 (inf/nan result sent to the UI).

reset.desc: Resets distance, time, send timer (1 s), previous fuel and starting fuel. Called on load; can be used to restart a trip.

updateGFX.desc: Called every graphics frame via extensions.hook('updateGFX'). Integrates distance and time, then about every real second computes the statistics and calls guihooks.trigger('tripData', data).

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Load hook: returns false (unload) if the vehicle has neither wheels nor a powertrain device, otherwise calls reset().

returns.desc: false to request unloading, nil otherwise.

onPlayersChanged.desc: Hook called by main.lua when the seated players change; unloads the extension (extensions.unload) if there is no player left or if the vehicle is unsuitable.

anyPlayerSeated.desc: true if at least one player is seated in this vehicle.
